content.text:
I have two test calculation errors. Let me fix them:

1. 2024 is a leap year with 366 days, so adding 365 days to Jan 1 gives Dec 31, not Jan 1 of next year
2. From Jan 1 to Dec 31 of a leap year is 365 days difference (day 366 - day 1)
